title: Shared register line
description: One line of a product's register: open questions, assumptions and decisions. JSON Lines, UTF-8, append-only, one object per line, stored in the product folder (default .po/register.jsonl). Never edit or delete a line; a change of state is a new update line. Same shape as ai-sdlc-loop's surface register, with decision added and blocker left out (a blocker is a question with urgency high). Validate each line against this schema.

status.description: open: declared, not yet looked at. surfaced: put in front of the user. answered: the user answered, or confirmed or rejected the assumption. dismissed: settled from the evidence, reason in note. duplicate: same as the entry in ref. decided: a decision in force. superseded: a decision replaced by a later one, named in ref.

type.description: assumption: decided without being able to confirm it. question: could not settle it, wants an answer, ideally with a recommended answer in text. decision: a choice made, by the user or by po on the user's behalf, including a user overruling the challenger. feedback: the user's feedback on an output (learning loop), full record in .po/feedback.jsonl, named in record. attribution: the tracer's finding for a feedback line, full record in .po/attributions.jsonl, named in record; answered with answer confirmed or rejected once the user has seen it.

record.description: For types feedback and attribution: the id of the full record.

text.description: One-line statement, verbatim from the agent's register request.

impact.description: What goes wrong if this is wrong.

urgency.description: How soon the user's view is needed.

item_ids.description: Stable IDs of the output items this entry is about, so traces can link to it (trace.schema.json).

ref.description: The id of the entry this line changes.
